dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I heard that another shipment of goods was stranded in Ritou due to piracy."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "This is ridiculous! Piracy hasn't been a problem for centuries ever since the end of Ako Domeki's reign of terror."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "As it stands, the Sakoku Decree has actually helped to revive smuggling and piracy..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "If this is the will of Her Excellency the Ogosho... the will of an Archon, us mortals simply cannot fathom its meaning."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: It would be advisable for you to not attempt to fathom it.
